title: Decarbonization without deindustrialization in future pathways for European industry
abstract: arXiv:2510.08199v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decarbonizing European industry while maintaining international competitiveness are two central objectives of European Union (EU) policy, yet they may conflict. This study investigates trade-offs between these goals across alternative industrial production pathways, from continued decline to policy-driven reindustrialization, focusing on steel, cement, methanol, ammonia, and high-value chemicals. Using an extended PyPSA-Eur energy system model with detailed process-level representation, we compare domestic low-carbon production costs against imported alternatives and evaluate three policy strategies: intra-European relocation, selective green intermediate imports, and targeted subsidies. Deep industrial decarbonization is technically feasible, with electrification playing a central role, but cost competitiveness peaks during the investment-intensive transition phase around 2040. Intra-European relocation delivers limited saving

translated_title: 欧洲工业未来路径中的“去碳化而不去工业化”
translated_abstract: 在实现欧洲工业脱碳的同时保持国际竞争力是欧盟（EU）政策的两大核心目标，但二者之间可能存在冲突。本研究考察了从持续衰退到政策驱动的再工业化等不同工业生产路径下，这两个目标之间的权衡关系，重点关注钢铁、水泥、甲醇、氨和高价值化学品。研究采用扩展的PyPSA-Eur能源系统模型并进行详细的工艺级建模，将国内低碳生产成本与进口替代品进行对比，并评估了三种政策策略：欧洲内部产业转移、选择性绿色中间产品进口以及定向补贴。研究结果表明，深度工业脱碳在技术上是可行的，其中电气化发挥着核心作用，但成本竞争力在2040年前后投资密集的转型阶段达到峰值（面临最大挑战）。欧洲内部产业转移所能带来的成本节省较为有限……
tldr: 本研究利用扩展的PyPSA-Eur能源系统模型对钢铁、水泥、甲醇、氨和高价值化学品进行工艺级分析，证明欧洲深度工业脱碳在技术上可行且电气化是关键路径，但需通过欧洲内部产业转移、绿色中间产品进口和定向补贴等政策策略应对2040年前后转型期的成本竞争力挑战，从而实现“去碳化而不去工业化”。
